arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has 1388 entries, with 47 malformed rows. The investigation will focus on identifying and addressing the root causes of the failures to get the backlog moving again. The failed_jobs table has been exported using pg_dump for the postmortem.
